input: M1 이상 맥(RAM 16GB)에서 100% 오프라인으로 도는 한국어 회의 전사 시스템을 만들려고 해. 외부 전송 없이 안정적으로 돌아가는 음성인식 모델이 필요해.
outputs: The model is designed for offline Korean speech recognition, making it ideal for transcribing meetings without any external data transmission. It supports the Korean language exclusively and is optimized for use on M1 Macs with 16GB of RAM. With a parameter count of 1.2 billion, it strikes a balance between performance and resource efficiency. The model excels in accurately capturing spoken language nuances and can handle various accents and dialects. Intended use cases include real-time transcription for meetings, lectures, and interviews. Its strengths lie in its high accuracy and low latency, ensuring a seamless user experience in offline environments.
